claim: The frozen knowledge debt was reduced from 18 warnings to 8 by authoring the two patterns the corpus actually attests (PAT-0003 Local-First Control Plane, ANT-0003 Claim Without Evidence) and by extending the lock to detect a stronger defect class: an id cited under a title that disagrees with the record carrying it.
scope: Two new knowledge records grounded in existing citations, one lock extension (title consistency), a scoped conflict register, and context-pack discoverability. No legacy record was rewritten; no pattern was invented to satisfy a reference check.
source: The 18 warnings reported by EVD-0076; attested citations in RSC-0001..RSC-0013; AGENTS.md section 2 for ANT-0003
action: Authored PAT-0003 and ANT-0003 from corpus attestation, added title/citation consistency detection plus a file-scoped conflict register to knowledge-integrity-lock.js, registered the new records in strict verification, and added the harness protocol and knowledge doc to the Context Pack TPC index.
expected: 'Checks Passed: 945 | Failures: 0', exit 0 (previous verified state 939; delta +6 = 3 required paths from the lock, 2 JSON-integrity validations, 1 evidence record), 'Warnings (non-blocking): 8', and 19/19 unit tests passing.
actual: 'Checks Passed: 945 | Failures: 0', exit 0, 'Warnings (non-blocking): 8' all typed knowledge-integrity (3 identifier drift + 3 frozen id conflict + 2 frozen dangling); unit tests 19 pass, 0 fail. Warning count fell from 18 to 8 with zero regressions.
risks: The title check can produce false positives on legitimate renames; it is deliberately strict and drift must be fixed at the citation, not tolerated in the lock.

PAT-0004 remains unresolved and frozen: two records cite it under different titles and no record exists. Arbitration between 'Thin Orchestrator & Bounded Subagent Delegation' (RSC-0002) and 'Hypothesis-Driven Chaos Experimentation' (RSC-0013) belongs to a human.
limitations: PAT-0003 and ANT-0003 are consolidations from cited records plus locally enforced policy, not new empirical research; both carry explicit evidence and known conflicts.
RSC-0001 numbers patterns under its own scheme, so three of its citations disagree with the canonical registry. Frozen per file, not per id, so a future mis-citation elsewhere still fails.
Three records still declare a non-canonical id field and remain warnings by design.
